# ROBOTIS interface asset retrieval log

Checked 2026-10-11. This directory intentionally contains no CAD binaries: the official motor drawing/STEP downloads could not be retrieved in this environment. The assembly images listed below are remote official GitHub assets and were visually inspected but not downloaded/copied, so no file hashes are claimed.

| Candidate asset | Official source URL | Retrieval/result | SHA-256 | License/source note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| XL330-M077-T PDF/DWG/STEP | [ROBOTIS XL330-M077-T manual](https://emanual.robotis.com/docs/en/dxl/x/xl330-m077/) — Drawings; observed ROBOTIS download records `https://www.robotis.com/service/download.php?no=1986` (PDF), `?no=1985` (DWG), `?no=1987` (STEP) | Download interstitial only in web retrieval; Chrome link activation did not produce a local `XL330.stp`. | Not available | ROBOTIS manual identifies `XL330.pdf/.dwg/.stp`; no file revision or hash was seen. |
| XC330-M181-T PDF/DWG/STEP | [ROBOTIS XC330-M181-T manual](https://emanual.robotis.com/docs/en/dxl/x/xc330-m181/) — Drawings; corresponding observed download records `no=1986`, `no=1985`, `no=1987` | Download interstitial only; no binary retrieved. | Not available | ROBOTIS manual identifies `XC330.pdf/.dwg/.stp`; no file revision or hash was seen. |
| X330 front/back/idler assembly illustration (`xl330_assembly_integrated.png`, 630×816 px) | [Official raw image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ROBOTIS-GIT/emanual/master/assets/images/dxl/x/x330/xl330_assembly_integrated.png); embedded by [official source include](https://github.com/ROBOTIS-GIT/emanual/blob/master/_includes/en/dxl/drawing/x330_drawing.md) | Opened remotely in Chrome and visually inspected. Not saved locally. Non-dimensioned assembly schematic. | Not available | Source is official ROBOTIS-GIT. Repository contains MIT `LICENSE.txt`; artifact-specific drawing/image license was not separately verified. |
| X330 horn screw illustration (`x330_horn_screw.png`, 1986×990 px) | [Official raw image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ROBOTIS-GIT/emanual/master/assets/images/dxl/x/x330/x330_horn_screw.png); embedded by [official source include](https://github.com/ROBOTIS-GIT/emanual/blob/master/_includes/en/dxl/drawing/x330_drawing.md) | Opened remotely in Chrome and visually inspected. Not saved locally. Non-dimensioned screw guidance illustration. | Not available | Same license note as above. |

The direct Python fetch of ROBOTIS download endpoints failed because DNS resolution was unavailable. The web tool returned the ROBOTIS download interstitial rather than file bytes. A later browser click on the official XL330 STEP link left the browser on the docs page and did not create the named file in the default Downloads folder.

Qualitative schematic observations only: the motor horn axis is drawn normal to the front/back face; the front and back frame examples each show four M2 tapping screw locations; the horn image calls for PHS M2×6 TAP where M2×8 TAP is crossed out. These images provide no exact interface dimensions, body datum origin, hole spacing, hole depth, output-axis offset, or horn spline geometry. See [`supplier_interfaces_followup.md`](../../reports/sources/supplier_interfaces_followup.md).

Do not place a STEP, PDF, or DWG into this directory until its official download has been inspected for exact variant/revision and its hash/license/source are recorded. Until then the items remain linked sources, not verified local assets.

**Later r12 update / public attribution (2026-10-14):** the qualitative XL330-series product image is now retained at `xl330_r12/xl330-series_product.png`; see [its source/hash record](../../reports/sources/xl330_axis_mapping_r12.md). This does not change the original unavailable-drawing results above. The e-Manual repository's MIT notice is copied in [ROBOTIS-emanual-LICENSE.txt](ROBOTIS-emanual-LICENSE.txt), with scope and source-specific limits in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
